edges.reason: transfer() delegates all logic to the private _transfer routine.
msg.sender is passed as the sender of transfer().
transferFrom() delegates to the private _transfer routine.
msg.sender drives the allowance spender in transferFrom().
approve() writes the spender allowance into _allowances.
_transfer routes the value movement to _tokenTransfer.
_transfer calls swapTokensForEth on the contract token balance.
An ETH payout to fee wallets is performed inside _transfer before the transfer accounting finalises, giving an external call inside the transfer path.
block.timestamp is consumed by the cooldown require inside _transfer.
block.timestamp is used to compute the new cooldown deadline.
_transfer reaches the cooldown deadline arithmetic when cooldownEnabled is true.
The timestamp-derived deadline is stored into the cooldown mapping.
msg.sender is compared against the router and pair inside _transfer.
swapTokensForEth makes an external router swap call while token accounting is pending.
swapTokensForEth grants the router an allowance before swapping.
swapTokensForEth reads the router address and WETH from uniswapV2Router.
The lockTheSwap modifier toggles inSwap around swapTokensForEth.
sendETHToFee executes native ETH transfers to external wallets.
_FeeAddress is the recipient of half of the ETH in sendETHToFee.
_marketingWalletAddress is the recipient of half of the ETH in sendETHToFee.
manualswap invokes the private swap routine.
manualswap requires the caller to equal _FeeAddress.
msg.sender is the value compared against _FeeAddress in manualswap.
manualsend invokes sendETHToFee with the contract balance.
manualsend requires the caller to equal _FeeAddress.
msg.sender is the value compared against _FeeAddress in manualsend.
openTrading instantiates and stores the Uniswap V2 router.
openTrading performs a payable external addLiquidityETH call before setting tradingOpen/swapEnabled flags.
openTrading creates and stores the Uniswap pair address.
openTrading enables automatic swapping.
openTrading flips the tradingOpen flag.
openTrading resets the cooldown flag.
openTrading is protected by the onlyOwner modifier reading _owner.
setBots is protected by the onlyOwner modifier reading _owner.
setMaxTxPercent is protected by the onlyOwner modifier reading _owner.
setCooldownEnabled is protected by the onlyOwner modifier reading _owner.
The onlyOwner requirement compares _owner with msg.sender.
setBots writes blacklisted addresses into the bots mapping.
setCooldownEnabled updates the cooldownEnabled flag.
setMaxTxPercent recomputes and stores _maxTxAmount.
The maxTxPercent argument feeds the _maxTxAmount computation.
_tokenTransfer paths call _takeTeam with the computed team fee.
_tokenTransfer paths call _reflectFee with the computed reflection fee.
_tokenTransfer zeroes and restores _taxFee via removeAllFee/restoreAllFee.
_tokenTransfer zeroes and restores _teamFee via removeAllFee/restoreAllFee.
_takeTeam credits the reflection team fee to _rOwned[address(this)].
_reflectFee subtracts the reflection fee from _rTotal.
_reflectFee accumulates the token fee into _tFeeTotal.
_getValues reads the active _taxFee for the t/r split.
_getValues reads the active _teamFee for the t/r split.
_getCurrentSupply iterates the _excluded array to subtract excluded balances.
_getCurrentSupply subtracts excluded reflection balances from _rTotal.
_getCurrentSupply subtracts excluded token balances from _tTotal.
_transfer enforces the _maxTxAmount limit on non-exempt senders.
_transfer checks the bots blacklist for sender and recipient.
The from argument is validated and used for all sender-side accounting.
The to argument is validated and used for recipient-side accounting.
The amount argument is required to be positive and within the max tx limit.
The tokenAmount argument is the amount approved and swapped on the router.
Each element of the bots_ array is marked as a bot.
tTransferAmount is emitted as the net transferred value by _tokenTransfer paths.
contractTokenBalance drives whether swapTokensForEth is executed in _transfer.
contractETHBalance is forwarded to sendETHToFee when positive.
path is the swap route passed to the router call.
currentRate converts the token team fee into reflection units.
The FeeAddress constructor argument is stored as _FeeAddress.
The marketingWalletAddress constructor argument is stored as _marketingWalletAddress.
The constructor assigns the fee wallet state variable.
The constructor assigns the marketing wallet state variable.
The constructor mints the full reflection supply to msg.sender.

normalization_plan.reason: The from parameter only exists inside _transfer and is fully consumed there for validation and sender accounting.
The to parameter only exists inside _transfer and drives recipient-side checks.
The amount parameter is only used for the positivity and max-transaction checks in _transfer.
tokenAmount is the sole argument used by swapTokensForEth for approval and router swap.
maxTxPercent is used exclusively to recompute _maxTxAmount inside setMaxTxPercent.
The bots_ array is only consumed by the setBots loop.
sender is only used to select the correct transfer variant inside _tokenTransfer.
recipient is only used to select the correct transfer variant inside _tokenTransfer.
tAmount is the sole token amount input used to compute the fee split in _getValues.
The constructor argument initialises _FeeAddress and its fee exemption.
The constructor argument initialises _marketingWalletAddress and its fee exemption.
tTransferAmount is the derived net token amount emitted by the _tokenTransfer paths.
contractTokenBalance is a transient cache used only to trigger swapping inside _transfer.
contractETHBalance is a transient cache passed directly to sendETHToFee.
rAmount is a transient intermediate returned by _getValues for use in the transfer variants.
rFee is a transient intermediate forwarded to _reflectFee to burn from _rTotal.
currentRate is a transient rate value used to convert the team fee into reflection units.
path is a transient swap route array built only for the router call in swapTokensForEth.
